actualSourceAudit.poseSampling: Four equally spaced source times per clip. Morph positions applied before joint/node transformations. Not full glTF conformance or biological validation.
actualSourceAudit.sourceViewsInspected: Two base-colour source-inspection views per uploaded file, using original geometry only offline. Source GT includes a colour-chart-like auxiliary object; Demasoni helper-labelled mesh excluded only from subject crop and retained in audit.

mantaEvidence.note: Morph inputs have substantial source-local scale contributions. Neither their magnitude nor scene trajectory is reported as physical fin excursion or natural swimming speed.

schoolEvidence.segmentation: Source-specific ten contiguous topologically isolated blocks with equal vertex/face counts, checked visually. Not a universal semantic segmenter.

features: unlit source kept distinct from relightable PBR
material slots not counted as colour variants
known variant mapping and base-material fallback
unknown variants and conflicting workflows rejected
per-channel sharing requires all compared primitive channels to agree

readerChecks.scope: Source identity, image/accessor coverage, increasing key times, observed poses, static GT, shortest quaternion path, truncated header rejection, synthetic morph-before-skin transform, and source-specific school partition. Not complete malformed-file or arbitrary-extension validation.

browserChecks.scope: Data-routing interface only. No WebGL renderer invoked, no native fish appearance or public navigation acceptance.
